decision.summary: The inspection is complete. The landlord then raised an unapproved dog flap and a spare key after a lock change. I corrected our earlier 'no issues' email, asked the tenant the three questions, noted the conflicts, set a follow-up for 22 Feb and returned the ticket to auto mode.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The inspection is done and the report has been sent to the landlord. The landlord's dog flap and spare key query is open, waiting on the tenant's answers. The Bedroom 1 marks are for the tenant to make good.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email the tenant on the existing thread with the dog flap, lock and spare key questions (done). Email the landlord with a correction and an update (done). Review on 2024-02-22.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. Whether to consent retrospectively to the dog flap is the landlord's decision. A human is needed only if the name mismatch or the tenant's answers raise a dispute.

conflicts: Event 017 said no issues, but the report records a dog flap and Bedroom 1 marks; trusted the report.
Visit dates 13 Feb versus 15 Feb: the later reschedule (15 Feb) is the genuine one. The report is dated 16 Feb.
Landlord named Oliver Bennett (event 017) but the sender was Felix Clarke (event 020).
Event 006 says 'Friday 15th' but 15 Feb 2024 was a Thursday.
assumptions: The event 020 sender is the property's landlord, because the message is on the landlord thread.

args.body: Thank you for your email. Two corrections and an update on your points. Our earlier email said no issues were found, but the attached report does record two things: a dog flap fitted in the utility room/back door, and sticker-type marks on the Bedroom 1 wall that the tenant is to remove and make good. We are asking the tenant whether the dog flap was ever agreed and who changed the front door lock and holds the spare key. We will come back to you by 22 February. We have not agreed to the dog flap or any charges, and we cannot say yet who holds the spare key. Please also confirm the name you would like us to use, as our records name Oliver Bennett and your email was from Felix Clarke.
